KA.what: CPU native (arm N, per-window sampler seed) vs the banked GPU `os` (a GLOBAL sampler stream consumed sequentially over 4,754 windows, bf16 trunk): BIT-IDENTITY IS IMPOSSIBLE (different device RNG AND different draw order), so this is a statistical agreement check against the brief's 0.05 m bar.

KB.what: displacement of the plan from native N (mean over the 6 S6 slots of the L2 distance, m). Forcing the head's OWN argmax class must move the plan LESS than forcing a DIFFERENT class (FB: F2 = CRUISE vs own = BRAKE_TO; CT: Fbrake = BRAKE_TO vs own), proving the force reaches the planner and that the F1 shift is not sampler noise (N2 = another draw).

CT_no_degradation.note: F2 is not run on CT by design (the brief); Fbrake on CT is the positive control KD, not a degradation test

KD_positive_control.what: forcing BRAKE_TO on correctly-cruising CT windows: ADE must rise and the plan must end SHORT (signed along < 0)
